 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

. The petitioner has challenged the order dated 07.06.2002 passed in connection with Angul P.S. Case No.55 of 2000 corresponding to G.R. Case No.232 of 2000 for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 312/376/420 of the IPC, pending in the Court of the learned J.M.F.C.,
Banarpal by which the N.B.W. has been issued against him.
2.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was admitted to bail on 12.05.2000,
however, he could not appear before the learned Court below leading to issuance of the N.B.W.
against him on 07.06.2002.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction, submits that, the petitioner would surrender/appear before the learned Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and seek remedy available to him under law.

4. On the basis of the aforementioned facts and submissions made at the Bar, the order dated 07.06.2002 passed in connection with Angul P.S. Case No.55 of 2000 corresponding to G.R. Case No.232 of 2000, pending in the Court of the learned J.M.F.C., Banarpal is set aside, subject to the petitioner surrendering before the Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and depositing cost of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees two thousand) with District Bar Association, Angul.
Liberty is granted to the petitioner to avail remedy under law after surrendering as per the undertaking.
